integrity: The proof is a self-contained analytic normal-fan support-function argument; finite checks are supplementary. The prior regular-triangle benchmark is credited and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only full-dimensional, origin-containing planar polygons with at most N vertices. Does not cover polygons not containing the disk center, other metrics, or higher dimensions. Historical priority provisional; independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp first intrinsic-volume shadow distance from a disk to origin-containing polygons
